title: Companion regard is tracked only as a hidden number surfaced by 'status'; the warning text ('If it happens again, I'm gone') gives no sense of scale, so after Brother Osk hit regard -2 there was no way to tell how close he actually was to leaving versus the warning being mostly flavor.
